Let me remove "idempotent".","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_q3dlreY9Ozonxw7u3oO17195","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call, saga } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): Proof<Response,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"idempotency-key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing idempotency-key header\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const outcome = saga([\n      {\n        name: \"reserve\",\n        run: () => call(\"inventory\", { path: \"/reserve\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"inventory\", { path: \"/release\" }),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"charge\",\n        run: () => call(\"billing\", { path: \"/charge\" }),\n        compensate: () => call(\"billing\", { path: \"/refund\" }),\n      },\n      {\n        name: \"ship\",\n        run: () => call(\"shipping\", { path: \"/ship\" }),\n      },\n    ]);\n    return Response.json({ outcome: outcome });\n  });\n}\n", "file": "handler.ts"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":29929,"completion_tokens":820,"total_tokens":30749,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":29824},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":288},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":29824,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":105},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
